title: Daily energy use of an office building
intro: The daily electricity use of an office building (kWh) on 20 winter days, with the heating degree-days (HDD, how cold the day was) and the number of people in the building. The model kWh = b₀ + b₁·HDD + b₂·Occupancy fits with R² = 0.977 and an in-sample RMSE of 12.4 kWh. Two checks of how it would predict new days: 5-fold cross-validation (13.7 kWh), and a hold-out test on 5 of the 20 days drawn with seed 1 (11.8 kWh). The Wind column is not in this model; the Learn page tries adding it.
